title: Raiders ownership takes massive shift with Tom Brady in place after $9.9 billion valuation

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Raiders ownership takes massive shift with Tom Brady in place after $9.9 billion valuation
sources.description: A group led by Silver Lake Managing Partner and co-CEO Egon Durban and Discovery Land Company founder and chairman Michael Meldman is continuing to acquire significant stakes in the Raiders.
